column1: # Verilator warnings accepted for soc_dm_4kb, one per line: file, class, signal.
# Classified one by one in NHAT_KY_RTL.md (2026-09-25); every entry is by design.
# scripts/lint_baseline_check.py fails on any warning not listed here.
# --- RTL ecf4fc03 (R7/R8/R9, NHAT_KY_RTL 2026-09-25/26). Previous list: lint_baseline_a0c425f8.tsv.
# Gone: product_su/product_uu (R7b merged the three multipliers), 4x PINMISSING vccd1/vssd1 (R8).
# product[65:64]: sign-extension bits of the 33x33 signed product; every result is taken from [63:0].
# b_imm_f[31:12] / j_imm_f[31:20]: copies of the sign bit; R7a reads instr[31] directly instead.
# load_byte_offset_w[0] and result_src_w: after R9b the datapath reads one-hot copies registered at M->W;
# the originals stay because the simulation-only R9 equivalence checker (hidden from OpenLane lint by
# __openlane__) compares every registered select against a decode of these real registers.
